sentences.text: Alexeyisaurus is an extinct genus of a possible plesiosaur.
The type species of the genus is Alexeyisaurus karnoushenkoi, first named by A. G. Sennikov and M. S. Arkhangelsky in 2010.
Alexeyisaurus was initially considered an elasmosaur in its first publication, but later research reclassified the animal as a sauropterygian rather than a specific elasmosaur.
The parent group for Alexeyisaurus is Elasmosauridae, and it belongs to the family Elasmosauridae.
Alexeyisaurus lived between 227.3 and 211.18 million years ago during the Norian stage.
